about.headline: Making is Learning
about.description: Teacher Studio is a hybrid learning community for formal and informal educators interested in hands-on, maker-based learning. Each month, participants make something together and share ideas for supporting maker-based learning in their own settings. The Teacher Studio is made up of school-based and out-of-school-based educators from a variety of hub locations, and is a partnership between UW-Madison, Wayne RESA, Building For Kids Children's Museum, The Bubbler @ Madison Public Library, and Fermilab MakerSpace.
